relations.subject: Jan Julius Lodewijk Duyvendak
relations.evidence: Jan Julius Lodewijk Duyvendak (28 June 1889 – 9 July 1954) was a Dutch Sinologist and professor of Chinese at Leiden University.

relations.subject: Jan Julius Lodewijk Duyvendak
relations.evidence: He was co-editor of the renowned sinology journal T'oung Pao with French scholar Paul Pelliot for several decades.

relations.subject: Jan Julius Lodewijk Duyvendak
relations.evidence: He matriculated at Leiden University as an undergraduate where he studied philology

relations.subject: Jan Julius Lodewijk Duyvendak
relations.evidence: and was soon introduced to Chinese by Dutch sinologist J.J.M. de Groot.

relations.subject: Jan Julius Lodewijk Duyvendak
relations.evidence: In 1910 Duyvendak moved to Paris where he began more advanced studies in Chinese under Édouard Chavannes and Henri Cordier.
